tools.name: listAccounts
tools.description: List all Hedera accounts with optional filters. Returns paginated results with account details including balances, keys, and metadata. Use for account discovery and filtering. Consider using specific filters to reduce response size.

balance.description: Filter by exact HBAR balance (in tinybars)

balanceGte.description: Filter by balance greater than or equal to

balanceLte.description: Filter by balance less than or equal to

tools.name: getTokenAllowances
tools.description: Get token allowances granted by a Hedera account to spender accounts. Shows how much of each token each spender is approved to spend. Use to verify token allowance amounts before allowance-based token transfers.

tools.name: getStakingRewards
tools.description: Get staking rewards for a Hedera account. Shows historical reward payments from node staking or account staking. Use to track staking income and verify reward payments.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp to query rewards at a specific time

tools.name: getPendingAirdrops
tools.description: Get pending airdrops for a Hedera account. Shows NFT airdrops that are in progress but not yet completed. Use to monitor ongoing airdrop operations.

tools.name: getOutstandingAirdrops
tools.description: Get outstanding airdrops for a Hedera account. Shows pending NFT airdrops that have been scheduled but not yet claimed. Use to track incoming airdrops and check airdrop status.

tools.name: getNftAllowances
tools.description: Get NFT allowances granted by a Hedera account. Shows which NFTs have been approved for spending by other accounts. Use to verify NFT approvals before NFT transfers.

tools.name: getCryptoAllowances
tools.description: Get HBAR allowances granted by a Hedera account to spender accounts. Shows how much HBAR each spender is approved to spend. Use to verify allowance amounts before allowance-based transactions.

tools.name: getAccountTokens
tools.description: Get all tokens associated with a Hedera account, including fungible tokens and NFT collections. Shows token relationships like balances, allowances, and ownership. Use to discover what tokens an account can interact with.

tools.name: getAccountNfts
tools.description: Get all NFTs held by a Hedera account. Returns NFT details including token ID, serial number, metadata, and owner information. Use to verify NFT ownership and track NFT collections.

spenderId.description: Filter by spender ID (for approved NFTs)

tools.name: getAccountInfo
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Hedera account including current HBAR balance, memo message, ECDSA public key, account relationships (staking, allowances), and smart contract status. Use this to verify account existence and check balances before initiating transactions.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp to query account state at a specific time

transactions.description: Include recent transaction information (may increase response size)

tools.name: getAccountBalances
tools.description: Get all token balances for a Hedera account including HBAR balance and all fungible token balances. Returns zero balances for tokens with no holdings. Use this to check if an account has sufficient funds before transactions.

tools.name: listBalances
tools.description: List all account balances. Returns all results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp to query balances at a specific time

tools.name: getBalances
tools.description: Get account balances with optional filters. Returns aggregated balance information.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp to query balances at a specific time

tools.description: List all Hedera blocks. Returns all results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp filter

tools.name: getBlocks
tools.description: Get block information with optional filters. Returns aggregated block data.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp filter

tools.name: getBlock
tools.description: Get a specific block by hash or number

hashOrNumber.description: Block hash or block number as string
